question: Which paper supports the claim that cobalt weave filters recover selectivity after acid fog exposure?
expected_answer_points: cobalt weave filters recover selectivity after acid fog exposure

candidate_papers.title: Cobalt weave filters after acid fog exposure
candidate_papers.text: This plausible partial paper shows cobalt weave filters surviving acid fog exposure, but it does not measure selectivity recovery after the exposure.

candidate_papers.title: Acid fog damage in woven cobalt filters
candidate_papers.text: This conflicting paper studies woven cobalt filters and acid fog, but it reports persistent selectivity loss rather than recovery.

candidate_papers.title: Primer on cobalt weave filter selectivity
candidate_papers.text: The primer defines cobalt weave filter selectivity and acid fog chambers, but it contains no recovery result.

candidate_papers.title: Cobalt weave filter selectivity recovery after acid fog
candidate_papers.text: Cobalt weave filters recover selectivity after acid fog exposure when rinsed with neutral buffer, supporting the recovery claim after the second retrieval attempt.
